FOURTHWALL_API_USERNAME.description: Half of a basic auth pair for the platform API. Fourthwall says to keep these credentials confidential because they reach sensitive data and actions, and only a super admin can create them.

FOURTHWALL_API_PASSWORD.description: The other half, covered by the same sentence.

FOURTHWALL_STOREFRONT_TOKEN.description: For the storefront API, which serves public shop and product data. Fourthwall never calls it safe to expose; it is public here because its own documented example passes it from a browser fetch. The name is convention.
